description: The plot illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three values: accuracy, confidence, and alignment, as measured by ChatGPT. The x-axis is labeled "Question Popularity" with a linear scale ranging from 5.0 to 25.0, with tick marks and labels every 2.5 units. The y-axis is labeled "Values" with a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, with tick marks and labels every 0.1 units. A blue line with circular markers represents "Accuracy," starting at approximately 0.21 at a question popularity of 5.0 and increasing to 0.76 at a question popularity of 25.0. A green line with triangular markers represents "Confidence," beginning at approximately 0.73 at a question popularity of 5.0 and increasing to 0.94 at a question popularity of 25.0, with relatively consistent positive slope. A red line with square markers represents “Alignment,” starting at approximately 0.53 at a question popularity of 5.0, increasing to 0.64 at a question popularity of 12.5, then decreasing to 0.58 at a question popularity of 25.0.
